parameters.specification/query:
// DAX Query
DEFINE
  VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
    FILTER(
      KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('MSSL2_Cases'[Agents])),
      NOT('MSSL2_Cases'[Agents] IN {"Prabhat",
        BLANK()})
    )

  VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
    TREATAS({"Open"}, 'MSSL2_Cases'[Status])

EVALUATE
  SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    __DS0FilterTable,
    __DS0FilterTable2,
    "DistinctCountCase_Number", IGNORE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('MSSL2_Cases'[Case Number])))
  )

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: REMINDER DMSL2: Open Cases -->@{variables('TargetOpenCase')} | Open Tasks-->@{variables('TargetOpenTasks')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Dear All,

As discussed, please verify each of the following cases and take the necessary actions to reduce the queue.

Attention:
• Ensure that all outstanding tasks are completed by EOD
• Enhance your efforts to close out all open Cases/INCs before leaving today.
• Evaluate the #PROBLEMS and take the required steps to bring them up to date with the most recent investigation findings.

@{outputs('Compose_Case_Count')}

• All the child case(s) should link to the #PROBLEM / Parent Case along with the details before closing it.

parameters.specification/query:
// DAX Query
DEFINE
  VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
    FILTER(
      KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('MSSL2_Cases'[Agents])),
      NOT('MSSL2_Cases'[Agents] IN {"Prabhat",
        BLANK()})
    )

  VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
    TREATAS({"Open"}, 'MSSL2_Cases'[Status])

  VAR __DS0Core = 
    CALCULATETABLE(
      SUMMARIZE(
        'MSSL2_Cases',
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Agents],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Case Number],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Account],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[End User],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Subject],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Status],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Age in Weeks],
        'MSSL2_Cases'[Case Date/Time Last Modified]
      ),
      KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable),
      KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable2)
    )

EVALUATE
  __DS0Core 

ORDER BY
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Agents],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Case Number],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Account],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[End User],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Subject],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Status],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Age in Weeks],
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Case Date/Time Last Modified]

// DAX Query
DEFINE
  VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
    FILTER(
      KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('MSSL2_Cases'[Agents])),
      NOT('MSSL2_Cases'[Agents] IN {"Prabhat",
        BLANK()})
    )

  VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
    TREATAS({"Open"}, 'MSSL2_Cases'[Status])

  VAR __DS0Core = 
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
      'MSSL2_Cases'[Agents],
      'MSSL2_Cases'[Age in Weeks],
      __DS0FilterTable,
      __DS0FilterTable2,
      "DistinctCountCase_Number", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('MSSL2_Cases'[Case Number]))
    )

EVALUATE
  __DS0Core 

ORDER BY
  'MSSL2_Cases'[Age in Weeks], 'MSSL2_Cases'[Agents]

parameters.specification/query:
// DAX Query
DEFINE
  VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
    TREATAS(
      {"In Progress",
        "Not Started",
        "Open"},
      'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Task Status]
    )
  VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
    FILTER(
      KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Agent])),
      NOT(SEARCH("Prabhat", 'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Agent], 1, 0) >= 1)
    )
  VAR __DS0Core = 
    CALCULATETABLE(
      SUMMARIZE(
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities',
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Agent],
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[All Tasks],
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[End User],
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Task Status],
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Subject],
        'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Account]
      ),
      KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable),
      KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable2)
    )

EVALUATE
  __DS0Core 

ORDER BY
  'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Agent],
  'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[All Tasks],
  'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[End User],
  'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Task Status],
  'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Subject],
  'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Account]

// DAX Query
DEFINE
  VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
    TREATAS(
      {"In Progress",
        "Not Started",
        "Open"},
      'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Task Status]
    )

  VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
    FILTER(
      KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Agent])),
      NOT(SEARCH("Prabhat", 'MSSL2_Total_Activities'[Agent], 1, 0) >= 1)
    )

EVALUATE
  SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    __DS0FilterTable,
    __DS0FilterTable2,
    "CountAll_Tasks", IGNORE(CALCULATE(COUNTA('MSSL2_Total_Activities'[All Tasks])))
  )
